insertionOrder._doc: Agent must insert in this exact order due to FK dependencies.
insertionOrder.1: m_fb_form_types → verify formTypeId for AF, PFVL, PFDFL, PFAL
insertionOrder.2: m_fb_form_mapping → get form_id for each officer step
insertionOrder.3: m_fb_page_master → create one page per form_id → get page_id
insertionOrder.4: m_fb_form_categories → verify or get category_id for FOR_DEPARTMENTAL_USE_ONLY
insertionOrder.6: m_fb_form_field → find or create base field entry → get form_field_id
insertionOrder.7: m_fb_form_builder_fields → insert with service_id + form_id + page_id + category_id + form_field_id
insertionOrder.8: m_fb_formfield_options → insert options (only for SELECT/MULTISELECT fields)
insertionOrder.10: c_application_workflow_configuration → insert workflow step rows (one per step)

agentParsingRules.skipButtonRows: Any BA field table row where Type = 'Button' or 'Action Buttons' → SKIP. Buttons come from actionAllowedJson.
